title: Lost on the bus
instructions: Bir kadın otobüs şirketini arayıp kayıp çantasını soruyor. Otobüs numarası, saat ve çantanın tarifine dikkat et. Bu sette 3 dinleme hakkın var.

script.speaker: a
script.text: City Buses, lost property. Can I help you?

script.speaker: b
script.text: Yes. I left my bag on the bus this morning.

script.speaker: b
script.text: The number fifteen. No, sorry, the number fifty.

script.speaker: a
script.text: What does your bag look like?

script.speaker: b
script.text: It's a small brown bag. My glasses and a book are in it.

script.speaker: a
script.text: Just a moment. Yes, we have it. You can get it at the bus station after two o'clock.

questions.prompt: When did she leave her bag?
questions.evidence: I left my bag on the bus this morning.
